label: Gaze
description: Eye direction and eye contact independently of expression and body posture.
notes: Direction of attention visible in the eyes, plus minimal head orientation needed to establish it. Expression owns eyelid tension and emotion; pose owns body and limb arrangements. Excludes named targets, props, places, and other people.

values.text: looking just to the left of the camera
gazing straight ahead past the camera
looking down and to the subject’s left
looking up and to the subject’s left
glancing over the subject’s left shoulder
looking sideways while keeping the subject’s head forward
looking toward the camera with the subject’s head turned left
gazing into the distance with the subject’s face in profile
gazing downward with the subject’s face in profile
